name: UNdata
tagline: Official SDMX REST/SOAP API for United Nations statistical databases
description: UNdata’s public API (powered by Eurostat SDMX-RI) gives programmatic access to UN statistical datamarts via SDMX REST and SOAP. List dataflows, pull data structure definitions and codelists, and query multi-dimensional series (XML, JSON, or CSV). Free under UNdata Terms of Use; no signup or API key. Not all UNdata datamarts are exposed until DSDs are mapped.

auth.details: No authentication, API key, or signup. Structure and data endpoints respond to unauthenticated HTTPS GET/POST (REST and SOAP).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free of charge under UNdata Terms of Use; no published numeric free-tier request caps

example.response_snippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--NSI Web Service v8.15.1.0-->
<message:Structure ...>
  <message:Header>
    <message:ID>IDREF39</message:ID>
    <message:Prepared>2026-08-08T21:15:38...</message:Prepared>
  </message:Header>
  <message:Structures>
    <structure:Dataflows>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DF_SEEA_AEA" agencyID="ESTAT" version="1.3" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Air emission accounts</common:Name>
        ...
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <!-- additional dataflows -->
    </structure:Dataflows>
  </message:Structures>
</message:Structure>

use_cases: query air-emission or other UN statistical series by period
fetch data structure definitions and codelists for a dataflow
download multi-dimensional UN indicators as XML, JSON, or CSV
filter series by dimension codes and start/end period
